title: Kenworth C509 Custom Built Powder Coated FUPS Compliant Road Train Bullbar #75
description: Kenworth C509 high tensile powder coated aluminium FUPS Bullbar. Heavy Duty pressed high tensile aluminium channel plus Cow Catcher with 3 small uprights. The main heavy duty aluminium box uprights extend to the bottom of the cow catcher with heavy duty end plates. Standard 88mm diameter pipe but optional 76mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Heavy duty tow pin with tow hitch outer protector plate and high tensile aluminium backing plate. One piece pipes through drilled heavy duty posts. Reversible Road Train/Over Size signs with powder coated cover plates supplied. Driving light and light bar mounts fitted to suit customer requirements. Dangerous Goods sign on heavy aluminium backing plate. Bull bar can be custom built to your specification.
